title: Apple says OpenAI leadership "normalized" misconduct and OpenAI's hardware business is "rotten to its core by its illegal reliance" on stolen trade secrets (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Apple says OpenAI leadership “normalized” misconduct and OpenAI's hardware business is “rotten to its core by its illegal reliance” on stolen trade secrets — Apple filed a lawsuit Friday against OpenAI over allegations of trade secret theft and breach of contract.
contentText:
Sarah Perez / TechCrunch :

Apple says OpenAI leadership “normalized” misconduct and OpenAI's hardware business is “rotten to its core by its illegal reliance” on stolen trade secrets   —  Apple filed a lawsuit Friday against OpenAI over allegations of trade secret theft and breach of contract.
